LightningComponentBundle.description: Chevron picklist path for nested LWC, Flow screens, and Lightning record pages.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object that owns the picklist field. On record pages this is usually provided by the page.

property.name: fieldApiName
property.label: Field API Name
property.description: Picklist field API name used for steps and optional LDS updates.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: Record id for wired value, record type resolve, and update mode. On record pages this is usually provided by the page.

property.name: recordTypeId
property.label: Record Type Id
property.description: Optional. When omitted with a record id, the record's record type is used for describe.

property.name: value
property.label: Value
property.description: Current picklist API value. Leave empty on record pages to wire the field from the record.

property.name: interaction
property.label: Interaction
property.description: event: notify parent; update: write via Lightning Data Service; readOnly: display only.

property.name: direction
property.label: Text direction
property.description: Leave empty to inherit org/page direction (recommended). Explicit ltr/rtl overrides inherit.

property.name: variant
property.label: Variant
property.description: Color preset. Override further with CSS custom properties.

property.name: celebrationValue
property.label: Celebration Value
property.description: Optional picklist API value that arms confetti. In update mode, celebrates after a successful save to this value.

property.name: value
property.label: Value
property.description: Current picklist API value. Output updates on step selection in event mode and after a successful update.

property.name: interaction
property.label: Interaction
property.description: event: Flow output value on click; update: write via Lightning Data Service; readOnly: display only.

property.name: direction
property.label: Text direction
property.description: Leave empty to inherit org/page direction (recommended).

property.name: celebrationValue
property.label: Celebration Value
property.description: Optional picklist API value that arms confetti. In update mode, celebrates after a successful save to this value.
